info.prompt: A cinematic ultra-wide shot of Farkle Frenzy's Frenzy Mode climax—four player avatars locked in simultaneous real-time play on a shared ten-by-ten grid where overlapping chain selections create a spiderweb of glowing cyan and magenta trails, the board itself a storm of cascading wild tiles and prismatic bomb explosions that cast flickering shadows across the skeletal gold UI frames, the entire scene backlit by the throbbing crimson glow of the Frenzy threshold meter as it pulses in sync with the escalating biological soundtrack.
